verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS CRM, so the axis applies. The only related evidence is an account-info API that reports the account's 'data hosting location'. That shows the location can be read, not that a user can choose a region or residency, so it is adjacent rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This endpoint provides insights into the account type, time zone, currency settings, and data hosting location.
